findings.title: Report actual PDF font embedding instead of only resolver capability
findings.detail: write_pdf(path, content="") reports font_embedded=true from the cached TTFont resolver, although independent PDF resource inspection finds no embedded font on the emitted blank page. The new field states an artifact fact and is also intended to support P3 independent output verification, so it must not assert an embedding absent from the file. Normal Chinese body output does contain the embedded font.
findings.requested_fix: Derive the field from fonts actually emitted/used in the PDF, or change/document its name/contract to unambiguously mean selected-font embeddability. Add a focused empty/no-text PDF assertion without broader unrelated retesting.
findings.resolution: Removed the unnecessary new font_embedded public return field. Existing font and optional warning contract retained. Independent verifier inspects actual PDF font streams for normal text, CID fallback and blank pages.

findings.title: Block cached ReportLab submodules in the missing-dependency fixture
findings.detail: The added missing-reportlab test sets only sys.modules["reportlab"]=None after earlier PDF generation has cached reportlab.lib.pagesizes and other submodules. Those from-imports still succeed, so the supposed missing-dependency call generates a valid PDF and the smoke fails. Independently reproduced as its only failed assertion. findings.requested_fix: Run the missing-dependency scenario in a fresh process before first import or temporarily remove/block every reportlab.* cache entry with complete finally restoration. Do not change production behavior to accommodate faulty injection.
findings.resolution: Fault injection now snapshots/removes every cached module under the package prefix, blocks its root, and finally removes newly created entries and restores the original entire module tree. Implementer corrected smoke log is ALL PASS.

findings.title: Require fresh PDF output from this renderer invocation
findings.detail: The helper reuses sample/renders and checks only the existing PDF headers after a zero renderer exit. In an isolated repro, invalid current inputs plus stale %PDF- outputs and a no-op zero-exit renderer pass without converting anything. LibreOffice also has zero-exit conversion-error modes, so repeated verification can accidentally accept old output after font/content changes.
findings.requested_fix: Remove the three expected old PDF files before invocation, or render to a fresh per-run directory, then validate newly generated outputs. A no-op renderer with old outputs must fail.
findings.resolution: Every renderer invocation now creates a unique renders-* output directory; successful invocation prints RENDER_DIR. Old outputs remain intact and cannot satisfy new output checks. Independent no-op/stale-output control now exits 1 for missing fresh report.pdf.
